items.prompt: Write a 3-4 sentence opinion piece about whether students should have homework every night. Include a topic sentence, two reasons, and a closing sentence.
items.answer: Sample: I think students should not have homework every night. Too much homework is hard because kids also need time to play and rest after a long school day. Also, homework every night can make learning feel like a chore instead of something fun. That is why I believe homework should only be given a few nights each week.

steps: Topic sentence: state your opinion.
Reason 1: use 'because.'
Reason 2: use 'also.'
Closing: restate opinion.

items.prompt:
Read the opinion piece below. Identify the topic sentence, the reasons, and the closing sentence.

'I believe that every school should have a garden. School gardens are wonderful because students learn how food grows. Also, gardens give children a chance to work together and care for living things. For all these reasons, gardens belong in every school.'
items.answer: Topic sentence: 'I believe that every school should have a garden.' Reason 1: 'School gardens are wonderful because students learn how food grows.' Reason 2: 'Also, gardens give children a chance to work together and care for living things.' Closing: 'For all these reasons, gardens belong in every school.'

steps: The topic sentence comes first and uses 'I believe.' The reasons use 'because' and 'also.' The closing begins with 'For all these reasons.'

items.prompt:
Revise this weak opinion piece to make it stronger. Add a second reason and improve the closing sentence.

Weak piece: 'I think we should recycle more. Recycling is good because it helps the Earth.'
items.answer: Sample: I think we should recycle more. Recycling is good because it helps the Earth by reducing trash in landfills. Also, recycling saves energy because making new items from old ones takes less power than starting from scratch. That is why every family should make recycling a daily habit.

steps: Keep the topic sentence and first reason.
Add a second reason with 'Also' and 'because.'
Replace the missing closing sentence with one that begins 'That is why.'

items.prompt: Write an opinion piece (4 sentences) about whether schools should have vending machines. Use at least two different linking words.
items.answer: Sample: I think schools should not have vending machines. Vending machines are a problem because they sell unhealthy snacks that give kids too much sugar. Also, students might spend their lunch money on snacks and not eat a real meal. For these reasons, vending machines do not belong in elementary schools.

steps: Topic sentence with opinion.
Reason 1 with 'because.'
Reason 2 with 'also.'
Closing with 'For these reasons.'

items.prompt: A student's topic sentence is: 'I think every child should learn to swim.' Write two reasons and a closing sentence to complete this opinion piece.
items.answer: Sample reasons: 'Swimming is an important skill because it keeps you safe near water. Also, swimming is wonderful because it is a fun way to exercise all summer long.' Closing: 'For all these reasons, swimming lessons are important for every child.'

steps: Write Reason 1 using 'because.'
Write Reason 2 using 'also.'
Write a closing sentence using 'For all these reasons.'

items.prompt:
Sort the sentences below into opinion statements and facts:
A) Butterflies are insects.
B) I think butterflies are the most beautiful creatures in nature.
C) Dogs bark when they are excited.
D) I believe dogs are better companions than cats.
items.answer: Facts: A, C. Opinions: B, D.

steps: Facts can be proven true or false. Opinions express what someone thinks or believes. 'I think' and 'I believe' signal opinions.

items.prompt: A student wants to write about whether screen time should be limited for kids. Write a complete 4-sentence opinion piece for this topic.
items.answer: Sample: I believe screen time should be limited for kids. Too much screen time is harmful because it hurts your eyes and keeps you from being active. Also, too much TV and video games can take time away from reading, homework, and spending time with family. That is why I think parents should set a one-hour limit on screens each day.

steps: Topic sentence: state opinion.
Reason 1: harm of too much screen time.
Reason 2: using 'also.'
Closing sentence.

items.prompt:
Rewrite this closing sentence to make it stronger: 'I like pizza. The end.'
The original opinion piece was about pizza being the best school lunch.
items.answer: Sample: That is why I strongly believe pizza is the perfect school lunch and should be served every week.

steps: A strong closing restates the opinion, uses confident language, and feels like a proper ending. Avoid 'The end.'

items.prompt: Write an opinion piece about whether kids should be allowed to have cell phones. Include a topic sentence, two reasons connected with linking words, and a closing sentence.
items.answer: Sample: I think kids should not have cell phones. Cell phones are not needed because children can always ask an adult for help when they need it. Also, phones can be distracting because kids might play games instead of paying attention in class. For these reasons, I believe kids should wait until they are older to have a cell phone.

steps: State opinion.
Reason 1 with 'because.'
Reason 2 with 'also' and 'because.'
Closing with 'For these reasons.'

items.prompt:
This opinion piece has a weak reason. Identify the weak reason and rewrite it with a stronger, more specific reason.

'I think every student should learn to play an instrument. Music is nice. Also, playing an instrument is good for your brain because it helps you focus and remember things better.'
items.answer: The weak reason is 'Music is nice.' Stronger version: 'Learning an instrument is rewarding because it teaches you to work hard, be patient, and create something beautiful.'

steps: 'Music is nice' is weak because it is vague and does not use a linking word.
A strong reason is specific, uses 'because,' and explains a clear benefit.

items.prompt: Write a 4-sentence opinion piece about whether zoos are good for animals. Use the linking words 'because' and 'also.'
items.answer: Sample: I think zoos are good for animals. Zoos are helpful because they protect endangered animals from hunters and habitat loss. Also, zoos are important because they teach people to care about wildlife and support conservation efforts. That is why I believe well-run zoos help animals more than they hurt them.

steps: Topic sentence, reason 1 with 'because,' reason 2 with 'also' and 'because,' closing sentence.

items.prompt:
A student's opinion piece is missing a topic sentence. Write one that fits.

'___. Playing outside is great because fresh air and exercise help kids think better in school. Also, outdoor play gives kids a chance to use their imagination and have fun without screens. For all these reasons, every school should have extra recess time.'
items.answer: Sample: I believe that students should have more time to play outside at school.

steps: The topic sentence should match the reasons and closing. It should state an opinion about outdoor play or recess.

items.prompt: Write the body of an opinion piece (two reason sentences only) for the topic: 'I think every classroom should have a class library.'
items.answer: Sample: A class library is wonderful because students can pick books they love and read them right in their own room. Also, having books nearby is great because it encourages kids to read more often throughout the day.

steps: Reason 1: write a specific reason with 'because.'
Reason 2: write another specific reason starting with 'Also.'

items.prompt:
Compare these two opinion pieces. Which is stronger? Explain why.

Piece 1: 'I like rain. Rain is wet. Rain is also cold.'
Piece 2: 'I think rainy days are perfect for staying inside. Rainy days are great because they give you the perfect excuse to curl up with a good book. Also, I love rainy days because listening to the rain is relaxing and peaceful. That is why I believe rainy days are some of the best days of the year.'
items.answer: Piece 2 is stronger. It has a clear topic sentence, two reasons with linking words, and a closing sentence. Piece 1 just lists facts and has no real opinion structure.

steps: Check each piece for: topic sentence, reasons with linking words, closing sentence.
Piece 2 has all three elements; Piece 1 has none.

items.prompt: Write a complete 4-sentence opinion piece about whether it is better to live in the city or the country. Include two linking words and a closing sentence.
items.answer: Sample: I think it is better to live in the city. The city is exciting because there are museums, parks, and many interesting places to explore. Also, living in the city is convenient because stores, schools, and hospitals are nearby. For all these reasons, I believe the city is the best place to call home.

steps: Topic sentence, reason 1 with 'because,' reason 2 with 'also' and 'because,' closing with 'For all these reasons.'
